round5: The son of Louis and Mary Caprio Genello, he grew up in Scranton's Bunker Hill section and graduated from Scranton Technical High School before entering the service. With his brother Vito (Gianello) he founded East Scranton Lumber Co. in 1956 and built custom homes for more than 50 years, living in a house he built himself. His siblings Vito Gianello and Mary DePietro died before him. His wife of 68 years was Ann Marie, and their children are Dr. Louis (Susan), Marisa and David (Kathleen) (S1).
occupation: "Builder; co-founder (1956) of East Scranton Lumber Company"
